catalog.family.alert.description: A message that stays on the page, in four tones, optionally announced and with an action.
catalog.family.avatar.description: A round picture of a person, or their initials, in three sizes and six tones.
catalog.family.badge.description: A short label that tags an item with a status or category.
catalog.family.button.description: Primary, secondary and destructive actions, with an icon-only button.
catalog.family.dialog.description: A modal that confirms a decision before it is made.
catalog.family.disclosure.description: A button that shows and hides a region, inline or as the title of a section.
catalog.family.filterChip.description: A filter control: a toggle in a single-choice row, or the trigger of a popup of options.
catalog.family.icon.description: The icons of the library, drawn in the color of the text.
catalog.family.input.description: A text field with its label, hint and error.
catalog.family.menu.description: A menu of actions that opens from a button, with the keyboard, options and a search.
catalog.family.radio.description: One choice from a group, with the arrow keys moving between the options.
catalog.family.searchField.description: A search box with a magnifier, controlled by its text, that Escape clears.
catalog.family.select.description: A native select with its label, hint and error.
catalog.family.tabs.description: One panel at a time, chosen from a list of tabs with a click or the keyboard.
catalog.family.tooltip.description: Short context for a control, on hover and on keyboard focus.
catalog.filter.name: Filter by name
catalog.lead: Compare the variants. Explore each component in detail.
